column3: “Moses and Elijah” supplies the pronoun referents.
“After” renders at the occurrence of the voice; the disciples supplies the subject.
“The disciples” supplies the pronoun referent; greatest renders greater.
“Had a little child stand” leaves taking hold of the child unexpressed.
“Day” replaces days; resolutely set out renders firmly set His face to go.
“Heading” renders the direction of His face.
BSB follows the critical text without the rebuke “You do not know what kind of spirit you are of” found in the Textus Receptus (πνεύματός).
BSB follows the critical text without “For the Son of Man did not come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them” of the Textus Receptus (ψυχὰς). “He and His disciples” supplies the subject.
